cards.hint: Think about the gap between presidential votes.
cards.quote: An election for president of the United States happens every four years on the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November.
cards.stem: How often does the election for president happen?

cards.hint: Look for state contests in the election year.
cards.quote: States and parties hold presidential primaries and caucuses.
cards.stem: Who holds contests to choose nominees in the election year?

cards.hint: It has electors who vote in December.
cards.quote: Electors cast their votes for president in the Electoral College.
cards.stem: In December, what body receives votes cast for president?

cards.hint: It happens in January after the votes are counted.
cards.stem: What event follows the count of electoral votes in January?
